nativeTurn.response:
Stopped-release retrospective evidence analysis. Only handoff, deadline retrospective and accounting work is authorized. Parent Codex-20261027T100516Z-plugin-session / req-20261101T113149Z-stop-handoff-deadline-report. Own Codex-20261031T142951Z-plugin-session / req-20261101T113943Z-stopped-deadline-evidence. No release action, test, build, model, provider, authentication, deployment or requirement change was performed. This sanitized report contains no raw reviewer stream, private profile, credential, model reasoning or server-availability assertion.

Conclusion (inference from the bounded artifacts): the failure was cumulative critical-path management, not one remaining UI bug. Earlier reviews repeatedly warned that local passing tests, source hashes and corrected individual lines did not establish the whole user outcome. On October31 actual higher-capacity tests still failed, a hosting migration-catalog omission was repaired, and public review receipts required privacy correction. After the final exact-source local gate passed at17:55:47, the remaining calendar day was consumed by incomplete reviewer execution, evidence-delivery/control repair and retries. The last review still stopped with admitted unread requirements/reports and70/55 after midnight. This is not proof every minute was spent only on those activities; provider/publication/other work could overlap. It is not a claim the user had not previously instructed shipment. Backup's native user-message timestamp investigation is authoritative for that question; no time for 'just push', 'deploy' or 'stop' is inferred from later assistant logs.

New production/scripts/tests were not consistently carried through requirements, independent controls, exact served bytes, producer provenance, current sibling docs, publication and actual hosting. This is a bounded reconstruction from seven Oct28/29 structured Claude verdict artifacts (including the incomplete round3attempt), selected Oct31 native chain/operational receipts, and the actual late canonical review bodies. It does not establish a complete Oct26/27 or Oct30 history; no absence of prior warnings is claimed for those dates.
